question: Mojtaba Khamenei seen in public by July 31?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Supreme Leader of Iran, Mojtaba Khamenei, is photographed or videotaped between market creation and the listed date (ET). Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For this market to resolve to "Yes," the images or video must be taken and released within this market's timeframe. The images or video must be authentic. Archival material, previously recorded footage, reused images, digitally altered content, AI-generated media, staged reproductions, or any posthumous releases will not qualify.

Digital appearances, including live broadcasts, will count for this market.

The resolution source for this market will be the image/video of Mojtaba Khamenei, and a consensus of credible reporting as to whether it is real.
research:
I couldn't make a forecast from this, but here is what I found. As of 2026-07-12 nothing settles the question: no verified photo or video of Mojtaba Khamenei has appeared since he became Supreme Leader on 2026-03-08. A memorial for his father that he is to lead, likely on Tuesday 2026-07-14, is the main thing to watch. Every page fetch failed (the proxy refused the connection), so everything below comes from search-result summaries and I could not read the full articles.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL. The deciding source is any authentic photo or video, newly taken and released within the window, plus a consensus of credible reporting on whether it is real. Archival, reused, altered or AI-generated material does not count.
- 2026-07-12: I found no qualifying image or video. Polymarket's event page is [here](https://polymarket.com/event/mojtaba-khamenei-public-appearance-by), but I could not load it.

## 2. Current status
- Not settled. Reports say no photo, video or audio of him has come out on official Iranian platforms since he took office. He has spoken only through written statements read out by others. [Times of Israel](https://www.timesofisrael.com/irans-new-supreme-leader-issues-fresh-statement-as-questions-linger-over-his-health/), [Yahoo/Reuters](https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/irans-khamenei-absent-persian-speech-161423944.html)
- Fake "first appearance" clips have already gone viral. One, shared by RT, was footage from 2020. Expect authenticity disputes. [Tribune](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2626088/fact-check-viral-video-does-not-show-mojtaba-first-appearance-after-becoming-supreme-leader)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-12 (approx.): His office announced, via Tasnim, a commemoration for Ali Khamenei that Mojtaba is to lead, 5-7 pm at the Imam Khomeini prayer hall in Tehran. Reports give the date as "Tuesday, July 23", but July 23, 2026 is a Thursday. It is probably 23 Tir in the Iranian calendar, which is Tuesday 2026-07-14 (my inference). Officials have not confirmed he will attend in person. [WION](https://embed.wionews.com/world/mojtaba-khamenei-first-public-appearance-iran-memorial-ceremony-1783850835381), [Siasat](https://www.siasat.com/ali-khamenei-memorial-may-mark-mojtabas-first-appearance-3506072/), [Ground News](https://ground.news/article/ayatollah-khamenei-to-host-memorial-ceremony-for-martyred-leader)
- 2026-07-10: Bloomberg reported his office would hold a memorial ceremony, prompting talk of a first appearance. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-10/iran-supreme-leader-to-hold-memorial-ceremony-for-slain-father-mrf1pwnj)
- Around 2026-07-10: A written statement attributed to him promised revenge for his father's killing. Ali Khamenei was buried in Mashhad. [Liveuamap](https://iran.liveuamap.com/en/2026/11-july-10-supreme-leader-ayatollah-mojtaba-khamenei-we-promise)
- 2026-07-09: CNN reported he missed the whole state funeral (July 3-9). [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/09/middleeast/irans-supreme-leader-missed-public-funeral-intl)
- 2026-07-05/06: Three of his brothers led prayers at the Mosalla, but he did not appear. The reasons given were Israeli assassination threats and reported facial and leg injuries; Reuters sources said his face was disfigured. Intelligence officials reportedly advised him not to appear in public. [Al Jazeera](https://aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/5/sons-of-irans-leader-ali-khamenei-attend-funeral-but-mojtaba-is-absent), [Al Jazeera 7/6](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/6/khamenei-family-mourns-but-mojtabas-absence-fuels-public-insecurity), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/05/successor-to-irans-slain-leader-khamenei-does-not-appear-at-funeral.html)
- Ongoing: The president, the judiciary chief and the parliament speaker say he is in "complete" or "perfect" health. None of this has been independently verified. [IranWire](https://iranwire.com/en/news/159360-iran-judiciary-chief-says-supreme-leader-mojtaba-khamenei-is-in-complete-health/), [The Hill](https://thehill.com/policy/international/6110716-masoud-pezeshkian-claims-khamenei-healthy/)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-02-28 to 2026-07-12: He has gone about 4.5 months with zero verified images, including after he was named leader on 2026-03-08. The Nowruz message (March) was read on TV, and he skipped his wife's memorial and his father's funeral. [Euronews](https://euronews.com/2026/03/12/missing-in-action-what-we-know-about-mojtaba-khameneis-condition), [Yahoo](https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/irans-khamenei-absent-persian-speech-161423944.html)
- So far that is 0 of about 4 monthly windows (March to June). The earlier Polymarket deadlines (May 31, June 30) appear to have passed with no verified appearance, though I did not confirm their official outcomes.
- Comparison: his father reappeared on video about 3 weeks after the June 2025 war ended, at an Ashura event. [Malay Mail](https://malaymail.com/news/world/2025/07/06/irans-khamenei-makes-first-public-appearance-since-start-of-war-with-israel/182960)

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-05-09 snapshot: the "seen in public by May 31" market traded at about 10-11% Yes, with about $307K volume. [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/mojtaba-khamenei-public-appearance-by-may-31-polymarket-0xabef6d91ad)
- 2026-06-24 snapshot (third-party mirror): the July 31 contract reportedly showed 69%. I could not verify this, and it looks inconsistent with other prices. [Polyguana](https://polyguana.com/events/mojtaba-khamenei-public-appearance-by)
- 2026-07-12 snapshot: the December 31 contract was about 35% Yes; another listing put the September 30 contract at about 51%, with thin liquidity. These numbers conflict, so treat them with caution. I could not get a reliable current price for July 31. [Polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/2771185)
- A related market, "Mojtaba leaves Iran by July 31", was about 2%. [Polymarkets.co.il](https://polymarkets.co.il/en/market/will-mojtaba-khamenei-leave-iran-byptptpt-20260720003505489/)
- I found no expert forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-07-31
- Probably 2026-07-14 (the "23 Tir"/"July 23" ambiguity is in item 3): the memorial ceremony he is to lead in Tehran. This is the most likely chance for a first appearance, in person or by video.
- An ongoing Iran war and diplomacy (an "8-month war", per CBS) means security risks continue to argue against appearing. [CBS](https://cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-trump-us-diplomacy-oil-prices-strait-of-hormuz)
- Muharram and Ashura 2026 already fell around late June. The next religious milestone, Arbaeen, is around early August, after the deadline.
- Continued Israeli reports that he is dead or seriously ill may push Tehran to release footage. Any release will face dating and authenticity checks.
